notes.title: 🎉Release Date Confirmed!🎉 "MATCH APP!" Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
The visual novel, "MATCH APP!", which is based on a dating app theme, is set to release on Steam on August 15, 2025!

It'll be priced at 4.99 (tax included). To celebrate the launch, we'll also be running a 10% off sale for the first two weeks! Don't miss out!
